problem.statement_latex: Given $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ by a phase oracle, sample $y\in\{0,1\}^n$ from a distribution within constant total-variation distance of $p(y)=\widehat f(y)^2$, where $\widehat f(y)=2^{-n}\sum_xf(x)(-1)^{x\cdot y}$.
problem.statement_text: Given $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ by a phase oracle, sample $y\in\{0,1\}^n$ from a distribution within constant total-variation distance of $p(y)=\widehat f(y)^2$, where $\widehat f(y)=2^{-n}\sum_xf(x)(-1)^{x\cdot y}$.
